key_insight: Attention heads in transformer models can be approximated by small sets of human-readable Python programs that capture their input-output behavior with high fidelity.
engineering_relevance: This provides a scalable route to inspect, validate, and potentially replace neural attention components with executable surrogates while preserving model performance.
method: Compute attention matrices for a head on randomly selected training examples.
Prompt a pretrained language model with matrix summaries to synthesize candidate Python programs.
Re-rank programs by how well they predict held-out attention patterns.
evidence_signal: Across GPT-2, TinyLlama-1.1B, and Llama-3B, fewer than 1,000 generated programs achieved over 75% average IoU on TinyStories, and replacing 25% of attention heads increased perplexity by only 16% on average.
watch_item: Program surrogates may be accurate on benchmark data but still miss rare behaviors or introduce brittleness when applied beyond the evaluated prompts and tasks.
